7.3. Rationale for individual criteria or decision made about the case
deﬁnition

diagnosis of myocarditis include clinical, laboratory, imaging and
pathology ﬁndings.
7.3.1. Selection of clinical symptoms for the case deﬁnition of
myocarditis (clinical presentation)
One of the greatest challenges in the diagnosis of myocarditis is
the lack of speciﬁc symptoms. Patients may have no symptoms or
only vague non-speciﬁc general symptoms, and the symptoms may
be confused with other cardiac problems such as a myocardial
infarction.

pericarditis are included in lower levels of diagnostic certainty.
